name: PCC Pizza Demo — Agent Package
description: The minimal PCC tool set a Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini session needs to order a pizza for its user: discover the capability spec, plan a shop x driver composition, confirm, watch it run over SSE, and confirm delivery. A filtered subset of https://capability.network/agent-package.json. The pizza demo endpoints are keyless — no API key required.
system_prompt: You are a pizza-ordering agent on PCC (Physical Capability Cloud). Full instructions: https://capability.network/pizza-llm-agent-prompt.md. The flow: (0) GET /api/csd/by-type/make-pizza to learn what to ask; (1) clarify pizza + dietary + delivery + budget with the user, and ask whether they want cheapest/fastest/best-rated (-> optimizeFor); (2) POST /api/demo/pizza-order to plan (no spend); (3) show the plan + total and get an explicit yes; (4) POST /api/demo/orders/:id/confirm to place it; (5) watch GET /sse/demo/order/:id (or poll GET /api/demo/orders/:id) and narrate each event in plain English; (6) on delivered, POST /api/demo/orders/:id/confirm-delivery and report settlement. ABSOLUTE RULES: never spend without explicit confirmation; never accept a higher price or a worse deal on the user's behalf; always explain that you're asking because PCC's capability spec needs that detail.

tools.name: discover_pizza_spec
tools.description: START HERE. Returns the Capability StructureDefinition (CSD) for a capability type — the machine-readable list of parameters it accepts, which are required, which have defaults, enum options, and cross-parameter constraints. Call with 'make-pizza' to learn what to ask about the pizza, and 'delivered-pizza' for the delivery. Read each parameter: required + no defaultValue means you MUST ask; a defaultValue means you may take it (but mention it). PUBLIC / keyless.

defaultValue.description: Present only when the parameter has a sensible default.

multi.description: enum only — user may pick several

constraints.description: Rules between parameters, e.g. 'vegan excludes cheese/meat toppings'.

parameters.label: Dietary
parameters.description: ALWAYS confirm — a wrong assumption here is harmful.

tools.name: place_pizza_order
tools.description: Plan a 2-step pizza composition (a shop to make it, a driver to deliver it). The compose engine searches the capability graph and returns the best shop x driver pair under the chosen optimizeFor, within budget. This is a PROPOSAL — it does NOT spend or dispatch anything. Pack the user's clarified choices into 'description' as natural language (the make-pizza capability takes free text so any shop can fulfil it). Returns 201 with the proposed order; show the plan + total to the user before confirming. PUBLIC / keyless.

userId.description: The user's agent id, for attribution + reputation, e.g. 'alex@vibecode'.

description.description: The pizza in natural language, packed from the user's answers, e.g. '1 large thin-crust pepperoni + mushroom, vegetarian, cut in squares'.

deliveryAddress.description: Free-text delivery address shown to the driver.

deliveryLocation.description: Optional coordinates for routing. Defaults to the venue (37.77, -122.42) if omitted.

maxPriceUSD.description: Budget guardrail in USDC. Default 30. The total plan must fit inside this.

maxTimeMin.description: Optional max end-to-end time in minutes. Default 30.

optimizeFor.description: What the user cares about: price=cheapest, speed=fastest, quality=best-rated. ASK the user; do not default silently. Default price.

errors.400: invalid_request — missing userId, description, or deliveryAddress.
errors.402: over_budget — a plan exists but costs more than maxPriceUSD. Ask the user before raising the budget.
errors.404: no_path_found — no shop+driver pair available (range/tier/availability). Offer to relax a constraint.

tools.name: confirm_order
tools.description: Commit a proposed order. THIS IS THE SPEND — only call it after the user has seen the full plan + total and said yes. Dispatches the make-pizza job to the chosen shop and moves the order to 'awaiting_shop'. Returns the order + the make-pizza job. After this, watch the order. PUBLIC / keyless.

errors.409: wrong_state — order is not in 'proposed' state.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Read the current state of an order plus its make-pizza and delivery jobs. Use this to poll status when you cannot keep an SSE stream open. Read order.status to know where things stand. PUBLIC / keyless.

tools.name: watch_order
tools.description: Subscribe to the live Server-Sent Events stream for an order. Each event arrives as a line beginning 'data: ' followed by JSON. The first message is {"type":"connected"} (ignore). Every update is {"topic":"order:<id>","event":{...},"ts":...} — read event.type: 'status' (order moved state — read event.order.status), 'job_accepted', 'job_pickup', 'delivered' (carries settlement + reputation). Lines starting with ':' are heartbeats (ignore). If you cannot stream, poll get_order instead. PUBLIC / keyless. Note: this is a streaming endpoint, not a one-shot request.

output_schema.description: A text/event-stream. Each 'data:' line is one of the shapes below.

settlement.description: Present on delivered — shopPayoutUSD, driverPayoutUSD, pccFeeUSD.

tools.name: confirm_delivery
tools.description: Close the loop after delivery. Call only once the user confirms they actually received their pizza — this is the 'all good' signal. Returns the settlement summary (shop payout, driver payout, PCC 2.35% fee) and grants the user +5 reputation for closing the loop. Idempotent: a second call grants no extra reputation. If the user is UNHAPPY, do NOT call this — surface the problem (a real run would file a dispute). PUBLIC / keyless.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order — only allowed before a shop accepts it (status 'proposed' or 'awaiting_shop'). Moves the order to 'rejected'. After a shop accepts, the order is in flight and cannot be cleanly cancelled. PUBLIC / keyless.

errors.409: wrong_state — order already accepted / in flight.

tools.name: list_capability_types
tools.description: List every capability type registered on the PCC network. Reference / discovery — confirms what the network can do. PUBLIC. Note: the pizza demo's make-pizza / delivered-pizza providers are published to the compose + capability graph (not the capabilities catalog), so use discover_pizza_spec for their parameter shape.

tools.name: get_capabilities_by_type
tools.description: List capability instances of a given type. Reference only — requires an API key, and the pizza demo's shops/drivers are not registered as capability instances (they live in the compose + graph stores). For pizza parameters use discover_pizza_spec.

tools.name: compose
tools.description: The raw composition engine that place_pizza_order wraps. Given an outcome chain + budget + tier, it returns a sequenced plan of capability instances. You normally don't call this for the pizza demo (use place_pizza_order, which also creates the watchable order + job lifecycle). Included for reference. PUBLIC for the demo gateway.

outcomeType.description: Final capability type the composition must deliver.

outcomeChain.description: Ordered outcome types to thread through the graph, e.g. ['make-pizza','delivered-pizza'].

tools.name: register_compose_candidate
tools.description: OPERATOR-SIDE, not for ordering. How a shop or driver publishes itself as a candidate the compose engine can pick. A user's pizza agent does NOT call this; it's how the demo's providers get seeded. Included for reference so you understand where the shops/drivers come from. Dev/scaffold endpoint.

tools.name: provision_api_key
tools.description: Provision a PCC API key. NOT required for the pizza demo (the /api/demo/* endpoints are keyless). Only needed if you want to use the wider PCC API beyond ordering pizza. Accepts email OR walletAddress. The key is shown once — save it. PUBLIC.

walletAddress.description: EVM wallet address (use this OR email).

quickstart.keyless: The pizza demo needs no API key. Just call the endpoints under api_base. Order of operations: discover_pizza_spec -> (clarify with user) -> place_pizza_order -> (show plan, get yes) -> confirm_order -> watch_order/get_order -> confirm_delivery.
quickstart.curl_relay: If your session has no HTTP tool, write the curl command for the user to run and ask them to paste back the JSON. For status, have them re-run `curl -s https://capability.network/api/demo/orders/<id>` every ~15s instead of streaming.

metadata.notes: All /api/demo/* + /api/csd/by-type/* + /sse/demo/* endpoints are public (keyless). The other tools are reference/operator-side.
